fields.description: The Grove site that serves AI, e.g. https://grove.frappe.cloud. Teams are registered there as Grove users named by their team id.
fields.label: Grove URL

fields.description: Minted by Grove for Central on Enroll.
fields.label: Control Credentials

fields.description: The Grove geography the pool's keys are minted in, one of Grove's geography names. A key works from any region and dials this geography's gateway; a key minted earlier keeps its own.
fields.label: Trial Key Geography

fields.description: How many trial keys Central keeps minted and ready for free-trial servers, under the Grove Team Central Trial; a job every 5 minutes refills the pool. 0 keeps the pool off: a trial server then gets no key.
fields.label: Trial Pool Size

fields.description: What one trial key may spend for its whole life, whole USD. Sent with every mint; a change applies to keys minted after it.
fields.label: Trial Key Cap (USD)

fields.description: Stops the 5-minute job from minting new keys. The pool keeps its size and its ready keys; retries of revokes and hand-overs still run.
fields.label: Pause Pool Refill

fields.description: Stops a new free-trial server from taking a key from the pool. It boots without one, as with an empty pool; a server that already holds a key keeps it.
fields.label: Pause Key Assignment
